### The Little Black Dress of Faith
Author: Gwen Smith
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-july-16-2020.html
Passage: James 3:17
Points:
- Heavenly wisdom is essential for every believer and contrasts sharply with worldly values.
- Culture and media constantly exert pressure to embrace compromise and self-centered thinking.
- Remembering God's pure and gentle wisdom restrains us from venting anger and indulging worldly habits.
- Christians always have the choice to align their conduct and responses with God's Word.

### A Prayer for Strife in Friendships
Author: Emily Rose Massey
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-strife-in-friendships.html
Passage: James 3:16-17
Points:
- Selfish ambition and the desire to win arguments can masquerade as righteous defense of truth.
- Harboring jealousy and self-centered motives produces division and damages relationships.
- Wisdom from above calls believers to approach disagreements with gentleness, purity, and mercy.
- Walking in peace requires relying on God's grace rather than letting personal pride dictate our reactions.
